name: Nukus

queries.query: Nukus Uzbekistan official cadastral map parcel public viewer API cadastre
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Uzbekistan National Geoinformation Portal at open.ngis.uz, the official State Cadastre Chamber site, and the Qoraqalpog‘iston regional cadastral branch in Nukus. A catalog describing the portal also exposed the ArcGIS REST host db.ngis.uz/db/rest/services, but this is secondary discovery evidence pending direct service verification.

queries.query: Nukus O'zbekiston kadastr xaritasi rasmiy portal uchastka
queries.result: Native-language discovery confirmed the official National Geoinformation Portal and official Qoraqalpog‘iston cadastral administration in Nukus. Government digital-service material describes open.ngis.uz as providing public information from the real-estate rights register, including cadastral number, location and use purpose; it does not expose a verified anonymous parcel geometry response in the search result.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Uzbek first-party discovery, followed by bounded TLS-verified GET attempts; no credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or global TLS disablement.

portalsFound.observation: Official National Geoinformation Portal of the Cadastre Agency; indexed page describes cadastral-number lookup and map layers, but the portal did not return within the bounded direct request.
ArcGIS REST services endpoint associated with the official portal by catalog evidence; bounded direct request timed out, so service folders, layers, schema, CRS and parcel response were not verified.
Official State Cadastre Chamber site lists the Qoraqalpog‘iston Republic regional administration at G‘aresizlik MFY, O‘zbekiston ko‘chasi 121, Nukus, establishing local cadastral custody.
Official government registry-office directory identifies a Nukus city registry office and a Nukus district registry office; this is local registry administration evidence, not parcel geometry.

requests.assessment: TLS-verified bounded request timed out; no HTML, JavaScript, configuration, map extent, schema or API route was obtained. Not evidence of citywide absence.
TLS-verified bounded ArcGIS REST request timed out; no service listing or layer schema was obtained. No follow-on feature request was issued.
Official site content was inspected through indexed first-party results; local Qoraqalpog‘iston/Nukus administration was evidenced, but no public parcel feature response was obtained.
Official directory result identified Nukus registry offices; no parcel geometry or schema was requested or retained.

safeFieldAllowlist: full parcel polygon or multipolygon geometry
geometryQuality: No parcel geometry obtained; no sample GeoJSON written.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Uzbekistan National Geoinformation Portal and the local Qoraqalpog‘iston cadastral/registry administration serving Nukus.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local custodial and official portal evidence only; anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry coverage was not verified.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review remains required
remainingUncertainty: The current portal JavaScript/configuration, ArcGIS service listing, parcel layer names, native identity field, CRS, map extent and citywide completeness remain unresolved because direct portal and REST requests timed out. This is an access/inspection limit, not evidence of cadastral absence. The exact WUP point was preserved and never shifted; no exact-point hit or miss was inferred.
nextStep: A later attempt may retry the official portal and ArcGIS REST host, then issue only a bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry request if a public parcel layer and safe schema are exposed.
